name: il.co.narabotu/narabotu
title: NaRabotu — jobs in Israel
description: Jobs in Israel (Russian/Hebrew): search vacancies, post a job or a job-seeker profile from the chat.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search active vacancies on NaRabotu by keywords, city, profession and quick filters (no_experience, no_hebrew, part_time, transport, morning, salary, direct…). Returns public vacancy cards with links.

locale.description: Language of names and links (default ru).

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Full public details of one vacancy on NaRabotu by its id.

locale.description: Language of names and links (default ru).

tools.name: lookup
tools.description: Find ids of Israeli cities or professions by a name in Russian, Hebrew or English.

tools.name: salary_stats
tools.description: Typical pay for a profession (optionally in a city) from NaRabotu job ads over the last 180 days: middle 50% and median, per hour or per month, plus the current Israeli minimum wage. Use when someone asks "how much do they pay for…".

locale.description: Language of names and links (default ru).

tools.name: calc_pay
tools.description: Calculates by Israeli rules (dates of the checked rules are returned): mode="net" — monthly take-home pay from gross (income tax, Bituah Leumi, pension); mode="overtime" — pay for one week with overtime, night shifts and Shabbat/holiday work (125/150/175/200%). Use when a worker asks what they should be paid. An estimate, not legal advice.

locale.description: Language of names and links (default ru).

gender.description: mode=net: affects basic tax credit points.

extra_credit_points.description: mode=net: extra tax credit points (children, new immigrant, residence), only if the user knows them.

rest.description: Shabbat, holiday or the weekly rest day.

tools.name: worker_rights
tools.description: Short plain-language rules of Israeli labour law for employees (minimum wage, hours and overtime, rest day, night shifts, payslip, pension, sick days, vacation, travel, dismissal and severance, agencies that ask for money), in Russian or Hebrew, with where to get help. General information, not legal advice — pass the disclaimer on.

locale.description: Language of names and links (default ru).

tools.name: get_form
tools.description: Returns the NaRabotu posting form as data: fields, allowed values and rules for a vacancy (kind="job", employers and agencies) or a "looking for work" profile (kind="seek", job seekers).

locale.description: Language of names and links (default ru).

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Submits a filled posting form (one ad in fields, or up to 50 vacancies in items). NaRabotu validates it like its own site form and returns field errors, or saves a draft. With an e-mail, NaRabotu sends a 6-digit confirmation code to that address and returns a draft_id; without an e-mail it returns a link where the user publishes on the site. Nothing is published at this step.

locale.description: Language of names and links (default ru).

fields.description: One ad: field values by the posting form field names (city and profession may be names).

items.description: Several vacancies (kind="job" only), up to 50; each like fields.

email.description: The user's e-mail: the confirmation code is sent there; the ads belong to this account (created if new).

tools.name: subscribe_alerts
tools.description: Subscribes the user to e-mails about new NaRabotu vacancies for a search (profession, city, keywords, quick filters) — checked every 15 minutes, one-click unsubscribe in every e-mail. NaRabotu sends a 6-digit code to the user's e-mail; when the user tells you the code, call confirm_draft. Offer it when a search has few results or the user wants to keep watching.

filters.description: Quick filter ids, as in search_jobs.

locale.description: Language of names and links (default ru).

tools.name: confirm_draft
tools.description: Publishes a draft from the account of the e-mail owner, using the 6-digit code NaRabotu sent to that e-mail. The code proves the user’s consent; ads then go to moderation. A draft allows 5 attempts.

tools.name: open_form
tools.description: Shows an interactive NaRabotu posting form in the chat for a job seeker’s "looking for work" profile (kind="seek") or an employer’s vacancy (kind="job"), pre-filled with the given values. The user completes it, confirms with a code from e-mail and publishes without leaving the chat.

locale.description: Language of names and links (default ru).

prefill.description: Known field values, using the posting form field names (e.g. city, professions, display_name, title, description, email, employer).

tools.name: publish
tools.description: Publishes a vacancy (or up to 50 vacancies in items) or a "looking for work" profile directly from the NaRabotu account the user connected with "Sign in with NaRabotu" (OAuth). NaRabotu validates it like its site form; ads then go to moderation, trusted publishers go live at once.

locale.description: Language of names and links (default ru).

fields.description: One ad: field values by the posting form field names (city and profession may be names).
